Chapter 7047: Bullet’S Power

Chapter 7047: Bullet’s Power

“Boom!” The bullet penetrated both the bulwark and the armor plates, hitting its final mark.

Heaven’s Equal roared and used his primordial dao to reinforce his Heaven Carapace, boosting it to the limit. He rooted himself and became one with heaven and earth.

This should have been an unbreakable and immovable state. Alas, the bullet still exploded and sent him to the edge of Dusk Realm.

“Rumble!” He smashed through the stars and fell in an arc to a desert wasteland, shattering it entirely.

He lay in the colossal crater with blood pouring from a terrible hole on his shoulder. Others gasped upon seeing the obliterated wound.

He was not wounded to this level after fighting Ash-serpent and Immortal Bronze. However, this weapon broke through his defenses and bones.

“Incredible.” Heaven’s Equal took a deep breath while looking at the injury.

“Afraid now? It’s too late, our trump card is beyond your imagination.” Immortal Bronze uttered coldly.

“No one will stop us today, not even Li Qiye or a celestial immortal, we’ll kill them all.” Ash-serpent snorted.

“Is that so? Are you sure?” A leisurely voice sounded.

Everyone looked over and saw an ordinary youth.

“Li Qiye!” Ash-serpent and Immortal Bronze became startled.

Although Ash-serpent spewed threats with confidence, he staggered backward with fear upon seeing the man. Immortal Bronze felt the same way.

“Li Qiye’s here.” Spectators were horrified by his entrance.

Although they had ample experience and even survived the ancient wars, their legs still trembled.

“Going to kill me? I’m right here, eagerly waiting to see your ace card.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Y-you best watch it!” Ash-serpent turned pale, losing his composure.

“Not going to start? I will then.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Let us kill him, brother!” Ash-serpent relied on the shotgun.

“Very well.” Immortal Bronze aimed at Li Qiye and fired.

“Bam!” Although the bullet pierced Heaven’s Equal body and defenses, it shattered like an egg thrown at a stone upon touching Li Qiye.

The affinities still exploded but they didn’t injure him.
